new_result.statement: For A=[[0,D],[D^T,C]], top right singular vector v of D and P=I-vv^T, s3(A)<=sigma2(D)+||PCP||op.
new_result.proof_key: Replace D by its top rank-one term and C by only the blocks touching v; the retained matrix equals e q^T+q e^T and has rank<=2. Bound the residual in operator norm and apply Eckart-Young.

partner_applied.use: Either d1*d2>=theta gives density <=2sqrt(pi)/sqrt(theta), or d2<sqrt(theta); combined with the new theorem this forces ||P C P||op>s3(A)-sqrt(theta).

pinned_e5f_applied.family: A=[[0,d v^T],[d v,w w^T]] with flat orthonormal v,w on an even opposite bank
